applies_to: Antec Controls (by Price) LUME-1-X touch-screen room pressure monitors, BACnet model LUME11, points list v1.0.0 or newer.
summary: The LUME is a wall-mounted touch-screen monitor for room differential pressure. On BACnet MS/TP it reports room pressure, pressure mode, alarm and caution status, and lets the BMS set the alarm limits and delays and switch or override the room mode. Its four universal inputs and three outputs appear as AI/BI/AO/BO objects named after their configured use.
notes: Names in square brackets are filled in from the configuration (room name, input/output names, room mode names).
AI, BI, AO and BO objects are hidden when that input or output isn't configured.
AV 102-105 alarm objects are hidden unless the alarm is enabled.
Pressure units are in.w.c. or Pa; the range is -5.0 to 5.0 in.w.c. (-1245 to 1245 Pa).
The notification class object is printed with the identifier 'EVC1'.

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and baud on the device, then read AV 101 room pressure, MV 101 pressure mode and MV 102 alarm status. Write MV 3 or use the SCH 1 schedule to switch room modes, and adjust the pressure alarm limits on AV 102 and AV 104 if needed.

minimum_points.name: Room Mode Override
minimum_points.why: Room mode override from the BMS

minimum_points.name: Audible Alarm
minimum_points.why: Audible alarm: on, off or muted

minimum_points.name: [Room Name] Alarm Status
minimum_points.why: Room alarm status (low, high, input, door)

integration.enable: BACnet commands take priority over normal operation (control priority 1 = BACnet).
setup: BACnet MS/TP (RS-485), 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 baud; B-AAC, BTL listed.
Ethernet ports are for laptop configuration only.
See the LUME manual for setup of inputs, outputs and room modes.
gotchas: Object names change with the configured room and I/O names, so rediscover after reconfiguring.
Unused I/O objects and disabled alarm objects are hidden.
